text.name: FS25E_SETTING_ENABLED_TOOLTIP
text.text: Turns FS25 Enhanced on or off. When off, cached vanilla graphics settings are restored.

text.name: FS25E_SETTING_PRESET_TOOLTIP
text.text: Graphics preset. Off disables governor presets; other modes balance quality vs. frame time.

text.name: FS25E_SETTING_TARGET_FPS_TOOLTIP
text.text: Target frame rate the adaptive governor tries to protect. Choose a step, not a free value.

text.name: FS25E_SETTING_ADAPTIVE_TOOLTIP
text.text: Automatically raise or lower confirmed graphics caps to hold the target FPS.

text.name: FS25E_SETTING_SHADOW_QUALITY_TOOLTIP
text.text: Global shadow quality (CONFIRMED SettingsModel). Higher tiers cost more GPU time.

text.name: FS25E_SETTING_SHADOW_DISTANCE_TOOLTIP
text.text: How far shadows are drawn. Prefer steps over extreme draw distance.

text.name: FS25E_SETTING_MAX_SHADOW_LIGHTS_TOOLTIP
text.text: Maximum lights casting shadows. Maps to setMaxNumShadowLights tiers.

text.name: FS25E_SETTING_FOLIAGE_SHADOWS_TOOLTIP
text.text: Allow foliage to cast shadows (setAllowFoliageShadows). Can be expensive in dense fields.

text.name: FS25E_SETTING_MAX_LIGHTS_TOOLTIP
text.text: Lighting budget tier for active lights. Confirmed capability placeholder.

text.name: FS25E_SETTING_SHADOW_MERGE_TOOLTIP
text.text: Merge similar vehicle light shadows when safe (mergeLightShadows). Restored via split on disable.

text.name: FS25E_SETTING_VIEW_DISTANCE_TOOLTIP
text.text: Object view-distance coefficient tier (setViewDistanceCoeff). Blind ultra boosts can bottleneck CPU.

text.name: FS25E_SETTING_LIVE_TUNING_TOOLTIP
text.text: Opens the live tuning overlay for LIVE-apply caps. Full options come after Core interfaces.

text.name: FS25E_EXPERT_MODE_TOOLTIP
text.text: Show experimental capabilities. Default off — experimental options stay hidden.

text.name: FS25E_CLIENT_ONLY_HINT_TOOLTIP
text.text: The graphics governor runs locally on each client. Quality values are not synced over the network.

text.name: FS25E_WARN_EXTREME_COST
text.text: This setting can heavily impact performance.

text.name: FS25E_KEY_CONFLICT
text.text: Key binding conflict detected. Rebind in Controls or disable the conflicting action.

text.name: FS25E_SETTING_SHADOW_FOCUS_TOOLTIP
text.text: EXPERIMENTAL: setShadowFocusBox. Gen-1 risky — stored only until Core apply path exists.

text.name: FS25E_SETTING_FAST_SHADOW_UPDATE_TOOLTIP
text.text: EXPERIMENTAL: setFastShadowUpdate. Stored only; no engine setter from GUI.

text.name: FS25E_SETTING_RAIN_SHALLOW_WATER_TOOLTIP
text.text: EXPERIMENTAL: setRainShallowWaterSimulation. Stored only; no engine setter from GUI.
